description.en: Adds a Skills page to the sidebar with two tabs: Installed lists the skills installed globally for every DSH session and uninstalls each one the right way (through npx skills, or by deleting a manually installed directory); Saved keeps a personal list of npx skills sources (owner/repo, GitHub links, package names) entered through a Save dialog opened from the button next to Refresh, opens a repo from its title, deletes entries with a delete button styled like the uninstall action, probes each saved GitHub repository and labels it as an npx skills repository, a Claude Code marketplace, or unavailable, and expands the usable ones into a cached skills tree grouped by plugin for marketplaces, and exposes the saved repositories, their skills and marketplace plugins to other plugins through the ctx.bukaSkills Host service.
description.zh-cn: 在侧边栏新增「Skills」页面，顶部两个 Tab：已安装列出对所有会话生效的全局 skills，并按来源选择正确的卸载方式（交给 npx skills，或直接删除手工安装的目录）；收藏用来记下常用的 npx skills 来源（owner/repo、GitHub 链接、包名），点「刷新」旁边的「收藏」按钮在对话框里填写仓库与备注，点标题打开仓库、可删除收藏；每个 GitHub 仓库会自动判定是 npx skills 仓库、Claude Code marketplace 仓库还是不可用并显示徽标，可用仓库还能展开成带缓存的 skills 树（marketplace 按插件分组）；同时通过 ctx.bukaSkills Host 服务把收藏仓库、仓库里的 skills 与 marketplace 插件列表开放给其他插件。
